title: Subflow definition
description: Container object for a 'sub' flow that is really just a named array of steps that can be inserted into other flows

id.description: Unique identifier for the webflow template

meta.description: Abitrary struct of metadata to describe/enhance the webflow definition

feature.description: Preside feature that must be enabled in order for this subflow to be registered

steps.description: The steps of the subflow. Any subflow must have at least one step.
